This matches Southern_Bacterial_Wilt perfectly: "A white slimy bacterial substance streams from a freshly cut stem base placed in water."

The reference shows brown/tan vascular discoloration throughout the cut stem - consistent with Southern Bacterial Wilt. The test image shows the bacterial streaming test with white milky bacterial ooze streaming from the cut stem into water, which is the textbook diagnostic indicator for this disease.
